recommendations.Recommended action: Secure burgers supply and pricing; track burgers share monthly with an alert if it moves sharply.

recommendations.Finding (evidence): Lisbon and London produce 58% of revenue, and London earns 86% of its revenue online with no in-store sales.

recommendations.Recommended action: Pilot online ordering in Berlin and Madrid; measure new online revenue after 4 weeks against the in-store baseline.

recommendations.Finding (evidence): Sides & Other is only 7% of revenue at 1,000 per order, the lowest of all products.

recommendations.Recommended action: Run a targeted Sunday promotion; re-check growth once January and later data is available to separate trend from holiday season.
